commands.spookydoors.not_door: Block at %s is not a door.
commands.spookydoors.set_forced: Door spooky state set to %s. FORCED config currently ignores this state.
spookydoors.configuration.title: Spooky Doors
spookydoors.configuration.spookyDoorActi: Controls which doors Spooky Doors affects. OPTIONAL requires doors to be toggled on with the command, DEFAULT affects doors unless toggled off, and FORCED affects all doors.
spookydoors.configuration.allowHoneycomb: Allows players to use honeycomb on spooky doors to make them non-spooky. This has no effect when Spooky Door Activation is FORCED.
spookydoors.configuration.allowGhastTear: Allows players to use ghast tears on non-spooky doors to make them spooky. This has no effect when Spooky Door Activation is FORCED.
